perk.survivorcreator.angler.description: Fishing +2 and a fishing rod at the start; shorter waits and better fishing chances.
perk.survivorcreator.asthmatic.descripti: Running, jumping and carrying weight take a greater toll. A bad combination with hordes.
perk.survivorcreator.athletic.descriptio: You handle exertion better: ideal for running, jumping and fighting without tiring as quickly.
perk.survivorcreator.bad_aim.description: You struggle to control weapons and react accurately.
perk.survivorcreator.brave.description: You stay calm under pressure. Better suited to combat professions.
perk.survivorcreator.brawler.description: Short Blunt +2, Strength +1 and a small increase to knockback when hitting.
perk.survivorcreator.clumsy.description: Poorer body control. You struggle to maneuver in close combat.
perk.survivorcreator.elusive.description: Your footsteps are audible over 45% less distance, even when running. Crouching further reduces noise. Does not silence gunfire or explosions.
perk.survivorcreator.fast.description: You move a little faster, with a moderate bonus to keep chases balanced.
perk.survivorcreator.fast_learner.descri: Gains 20% more skill XP and keeps a small luck bonus.
perk.survivorcreator.fearful.description: Panic makes you miss and take damage more severely.
perk.survivorcreator.field_medic.descrip: First Aid +2. Starts with paper and honey; levels improve treatment and healing.
perk.survivorcreator.first_aid.descripti: You know how to stabilize wounds and survive after taking damage.
perk.survivorcreator.fragile.description: Wounds affect you more. Very dangerous with First Aid and fractures.
perk.survivorcreator.fragile_bones.descr: You take 12% more damage. Cannot be combined with Tough.
perk.survivorcreator.good_aim.descriptio: You control firearms and ranged combat better. Provides little improvement to melee.
perk.survivorcreator.handy.description: Better prepared for tools, repairs and maintenance.
perk.survivorcreator.hard_of_hearing.des: Deafness II: sounds play at 50% of their normal volume.
perk.survivorcreator.lucky.description: Better overall chances without making loot too easy.
perk.survivorcreator.marksman.descriptio: Aiming +2 and Reloading +1 at the start. Reduces spread and reload time.
perk.survivorcreator.organized.descripti: You start with organized supplies. Good for builds with limited weight or inventory.
perk.survivorcreator.outdoorsman.descrip: You adapt better to long trips, hunger, fatigue and life outside shelters.
perk.survivorcreator.poor_fighter.descri: Removes one starting level of Strength and Short Blunt; melee damage -0.5.
perk.survivorcreator.ready_for_trouble.d: With OK Additions, starts with a light shield and two stone bolas; also brings three loaves of bread.
perk.survivorcreator.resourceful.descrip: Maintenance +1 and, with OK Additions, a crowbar and tool lubricant.
perk.survivorcreator.runner.description: Fitness +1 and Sprinting +2; an additional 15% maximum stamina and 10% less food energy consumption.
perk.survivorcreator.scavenger.descripti: Maintenance +1, Luck +0.25 and a bundle to organize your finds.
perk.survivorcreator.sedentary.descripti: Fitness and Sprinting start one level lower; you use 10% more energy. Levels never drop below zero.
perk.survivorcreator.shaky_hands.descrip: Aiming and Reloading start one level lower; attack speed is reduced by 0.15.
perk.survivorcreator.slow.description: You move more slowly, making it harder to escape hordes.
perk.survivorcreator.slow_healer.descrip: You recover more slowly; every wound matters more.
perk.survivorcreator.strong.description: You hit harder and carry weight better, without making melee weapons overpowered.
perk.survivorcreator.thirsty.description: Your body uses fluids faster; dangerous with Tough As Nails or Homeostatic.
perk.survivorcreator.tough.description: You withstand physical punishment better without becoming invincible.
perk.survivorcreator.weak.description: You tire more easily and your melee blows have less force.
profession.survivorcreator.burger_flippe: Some cooking, few supplies and a low cost.
profession.survivorcreator.burglar.descr: Fast, discreet and good at getting in and out unseen.
profession.survivorcreator.butcher.descr: Short Blade +2 and Cooking +2. A cutting tool and food, without firearms training.
profession.survivorcreator.chef.descript: Knows how to manage food and prepare supplies.
profession.survivorcreator.construction_: Physical strength and endurance for heavy work.
profession.survivorcreator.delivery_work: Sprinting +2, the Fast trait, a compass and food; little combat equipment.
profession.survivorcreator.diy_expert.de: Home repairs, tools and quick solutions.
profession.survivorcreator.doctor.descri: Specialist in trauma, wounds and medical survival.
profession.survivorcreator.electrician.d: Handling electrical systems and technical supplies.
Tough, brave and prepared for dangerous situations.
profession.survivorcreator.fisherman.des: Fishing +3 and Cooking +1. A rod, fish and an improvised knife.
profession.survivorcreator.fishing_guide: Knows emergency food and outdoor living.
profession.survivorcreator.hunter.descri: Aiming +2, Reloading +1 and Fishing +1. Brings a bow, arrows and food for the first trips.
profession.survivorcreator.lumberjack.de: Strong and used to axes and physical exertion.
profession.survivorcreator.maintenance_w: Maintenance +3 and Carpentry +1; simple tools and materials for a shelter.
profession.survivorcreator.mechanic.desc: Knows how to repair, improvise and make use of parts.
profession.survivorcreator.musician.desc: Not a fighter: some food and OK Additions instruments to play during breaks.
profession.survivorcreator.nurse.descrip: Practical care and emergency first aid.
profession.survivorcreator.paramedic.des: Aid under pressure: First Aid +2 and Fitness +1, plus the First Aid trait.
profession.survivorcreator.park_ranger.d: Navigation, routes and survival outside the city.
profession.survivorcreator.police_office: Weapons training, discipline and threat control.
profession.survivorcreator.rancher.descr: Rural life, animals and outdoor endurance.
profession.survivorcreator.scout.descrip: Aiming +1 and Fitness +1. With OK Additions, brings binoculars, a marker and a stone tomahawk.
Metalworking +2 and Maintenance +2. Salvages and works metal with basic equipment.
profession.survivorcreator.security_guar: Used to patrols, watch duty and tension.
profession.survivorcreator.supply_runner: Sprinting +2 and Maintenance +1. Prioritizes mobility and organized carrying.
profession.survivorcreator.tailor.descri: Clothing, light equipment and managing materials.
profession.survivorcreator.unemployed.de: No formal training. Starts with more points but no free advantages.
profession.survivorcreator.veteran.descr: Combat experience. Mentally strong, but not overpowered at the start.

survivorcreator.localized.61: Houses and interiors: food, water and household supplies. Random locations on different floors.
survivorcreator.localized.62: Eastern homes: food, clothing and basic tools. Random interiors near containers.
survivorcreator.localized.63: City buildings: supplies, tools and office materials; greater exposure to zombies outside.
survivorcreator.localized.64: Buildings and offices: assorted supplies and medicine depending on the container. Randomly selected floors.
survivorcreator.localized.65: Shelters at the edge of the northwestern nuclear power plant. Very dangerous area; valuable materials and tools in the nuclear sector.
survivorcreator.localized.66: Buildings on the western edge, between both sectors. Food, clothing and tools depending on the container; alternative routes to the center.
survivorcreator.localized.67: Remote northeastern interiors near the pyramid sector. Supplies and materials; exploring large structures increases the risk.
survivorcreator.localized.68: Interiors in the far southwest, away from the northern residential area. Household and office supplies; a dangerous route into the city.
survivorcreator.localized.69: Buildings in the far southeast. Food, materials and office supplies; rewards depend on each container's loot table.
